model: 300 K scalar-PBE K-valley longitudinal acoustic deformation potential
package_contents: Native inputs, output text, standalone XML snapshots, planar averages, coordinate tables, scripts and figures. SCF charge/wavefunction save trees and 3D potential grids are regenerated by native QE.
coordinate_schema: offsetx_invA/offsety_invA are local Cartesian displacements in inverse Angstrom; GammaK_fraction is the dimensionless t in k=tK.
